reason: I like asking Claude what to do, but I'm the one who presses buy. Letting an agent move my real money, even with limits and a cute pet on it, is a step I'm not ready to take for a plan with no price and no named broker yet.
objection: I don't trust an AI with my money. Everything above a limit waits for my tap and there's a kill switch, but the stuff under that limit just happens on its own, and I don't even know which broker would hold my account or what happens if the agent gets it wrong.
would_change_my_mind: Naming a real licensed broker I recognize, with SIPC coverage, and letting me run it in propose-only mode on my real account for a few months before it trades anything on its own.
